class Customer(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'customer'

    # Primary Key
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)

    # Attributes
    name = Column(String, nullable=False)
    credit_limit = Column(Decimal)
    balance = Column(Decimal, default=0)

    # Define relationships/foreign keys
    orders = relationship("Order", back_populates="customer")

class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'order'

    # Primary Key
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)

    # Foreign Keys
    customer_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('customer.id'))

    # Attributes
    amount_total = Column(Decimal, default=0)
    date_shipped = Column(DateTime)
    notes = Column(String)

    # Define relationships
    customer = relationship("Customer", back_populates="orders")
    items = relationship("Item", back_populates="order")

class Item(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'item'

    # Primary Key
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)

    # Foreign Keys
    order_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('order.id'))
    product_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('product.id'))

    # Attributes
    quantity = Column(Integer, default=0)
    unit_price = Column(Decimal)
    amount = Column(Decimal)

    # Define relationships
    order = relationship("Order", back_populates="items")
    product = relationship("Product")
models.description: Item class with a relationship to products and containing quantity, unit price, and amount
models.name: Item

    # Primary Key
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)

    # Attributes
    name = Column(String, nullable=False)
    unit_price = Column(Decimal)

    # Define relationships/foreign keys
    items = relationship("Item", back_populates="product")

rules.name: Customer Balance Constraint
rules.description: Ensure that the customer's balance does not exceed their credit limit.
rules.code:
Rule.constraint(validate=Customer,
                        as_condition=lambda row: row.balance <= row.credit_limit,
                        error_msg="Customer balance ({row.balance}) exceeds credit limit ({row.credit_limit})")
